positions.as_written: Use the post-operative protocol, since metal or bioabsorbable fixation produces artefact at the two places the study must assess.
Assess the graft's continuity and its line against the notch roof, which are the same two observations the native ligament needed.
Assess the tunnel positions, which are measurable where graft signal is not.
Assess the rest of the knee, because the menisci and cartilage decide the outcome the patient notices.
